name: AcFormatConditionOperator
description: Specifies the operator to apply when using the Add method to create a conditional format.

constants.name: acBetween
constants.description: The value must be between the values specified by the Expression1 and Expression2 arguments.

constants.name: acNotBetween
constants.description: The value must not be between the values specified by the Expression1 and Expression2 arguments.

constants.name: acEqual
constants.description: The value must equal to the value specified by the Expression1 argument.

constants.name: acNotEqual
constants.description: The value must not be equal to the value specified by the Expression1 argument.

constants.name: acGreaterThan
constants.description: The value must be greater than the value specified by the Expression1 argument.

constants.name: acLessThan
constants.description: The value must be less than the value specified by the Expression1 argument.

constants.name: acGreaterThanOrEqual
constants.description: The value must be greater than or equal to the value specified by the Expression1 argument.

constants.name: acLessThanOrEqual
constants.description: The value must be less than or equal to the value specified by the Expression1 argument.
